executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across 3 test classes. Root cause: DTO constructors changed from all-args to no-args constructors (likely using Lombok @Builder), service method signatures changed to require additional parameters (userId as String, taskId as UUID), and ErrorResponse.getCode() method removed. All test classes need updates to use builder pattern for DTOs and pass correct parameter types to service methods.

errors.message: Constructor TaskCreateRequest/TaskResponse/TaskUpdateRequest cannot be applied to given types
errors.root_cause: DTOs changed from all-args constructors to no-args constructors. Tests instantiate DTOs using constructors with arguments, but DTOs now likely use @Builder pattern requiring builder() syntax.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace all DTO constructor calls with builder pattern. Example: new TaskCreateRequest(title, desc, userId, priority, dueDate) should become TaskCreateRequest.builder().title(title).description(desc).userId(userId).priority(priority).dueDate(dueDate).build()

errors.message: Method createTask/getUserTasks/getTaskById/updateTask/deleteTask cannot be applied to given types
errors.root_cause: Service interface methods now require userId as String parameter. Tests call methods without userId or with wrong parameter order. Methods like createTask(request) now expect createTask(userId, request).
errors.fix_recommendation: Add userId parameter to all service method calls. Update mock setup: when(taskService.createTask(anyString(), any(TaskCreateRequest.class))).thenReturn(response). Extract userId from security context or use test constant.

errors.message: Incompatible types: long cannot be converted to String/UUID
errors.root_cause: Task IDs changed from long to UUID type, and userId changed from long to String. Tests use long literals (1L, 2L) but methods expect UUID for taskId and String for userId.
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace long task IDs with UUID: UUID taskId = UUID.randomUUID(). Replace long user IDs with String: String userId = "user-123". Update all test data and mock setups accordingly.

errors.root_cause: ErrorResponse DTO no longer has getCode() method. Tests verify error code using response.getCode() but this method was removed from the DTO.
errors.fix_recommendation: Remove all assertions on error code: delete lines like assertEquals("TASK_NOT_FOUND", response.getCode()). If error codes are still needed, check if ErrorResponse now uses a different field name or structure.

errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler method handleValidationErrors() was removed or renamed. Tests call this method directly but it no longer exists.
errors.fix_recommendation: Check GlobalExceptionHandler for the new validation error handling method name. Update test to call the correct method, likely @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class) annotated method.

errors.message: Incompatible types: long/Priority cannot be converted to String/TaskPriority
errors.root_cause: Data store tests use wrong types: userId as long instead of String, Priority enum instead of TaskPriority enum, and attempt UUID arithmetic (taskId + 1).
errors.fix_recommendation: Update InMemoryTaskDataStoreTest: use String for userId ("user-1"), use TaskPriority enum instead of Priority, generate new UUIDs instead of arithmetic (UUID.randomUUID()), and update findByUserId() calls to match new signature with sortBy parameter.

summary: 6 grouped compilation error categories found affecting 100+ individual compilation failures
